method: 18 frames from the six chamber slots of the v4 render, viewed at 520 px (build/kanal_review_*.jpg), plus records/kanal_qc.json
findings: Off-model: only kanal_01 matches the tito character sheet; 03 (thin humanoid robots), 04, 05 and 06 (bald robot heads, different faces) do not. COMPANION K47 / M8.A requires the same character in every shot.
Generic look: smooth AI-default sepia diorama with soft bokeh; 04/05/06 robot faces read as stock sci-fi, not the brief's tito.
Low exposure: mean linear luma 0.032-0.129; 01 and 05 are near-black inside the frame.
Little story-relevant motion at viewing size: the jeepney (02) is nearly static apart from smoke; the gag lands after the 5.3 s slot in 01 and 05.
Nothing in them is about Lipa: no landmark, no data, no place link.
decision: Cut all six from v4 (K47: a generation is a draft until checked; failed shots are cut, never shipped). Files stay in uploaded_files only; nothing derived from them ships.
replacement: Brass odometer chambers: 3D digit drums roll on the bar grid to real numbers computed from this project's own data, each with a source line.
